title: Research as one editorial page
items: Every Research panel now carries a status label: Live (moves until kickoff), Season to date, or Graded (locked before kickoff, scored after the final).
The featured read sets Matchday against the market side by side, with each team's power rank and record.
Model–market watch now shows how disagreement has actually graded: 115–17 when Matchday agreed with the market, 8–10 when it disagreed, 6–10 backing the market underdog.
Risers & fallers shows the biggest move since the preseason (preseason, last week, now) plus this week's top three up and down.
Rating vs schedule has a Reading the chart panel with quadrant counts and the most- and least-tested top-25 schedules. Longshots that won shows six results with dates.
Matchday results adds a compact calibration view; Matchday in public splits @timurknowsball's record with and against Matchday. Panels sit on one 12-column grid, sized by what they hold.
